assets.prompt: Editorial interior photograph, wide 16:9. The entry of a light-filled Caribbean island villa prepared for arriving house guests: a generous welcome arrangement of white and blush garden roses, white lilies, pale pink snapdragons and soft green foliage in a low hand-thrown stone bowl on a pale limestone console table, centred in frame. Behind it, open white louvred doors reveal a soft turquoise sea and palm fronds, gently out of focus. Linen curtains, travertine floor, warm late-morning light with soft palm-leaf shadows across the wall. Calm, airy, refined, natural colour, no people, no text, no logos. Shot on medium format, 45mm, f/4, subtle film grain.
